description: monoforge's refusal-code registry, in the govstruct spec/refusals.json shape (the G10 model): one namespaced vocabulary so a refusal one tool emits is a refusal the next tool can read. The harness refuses to emit a code it has not registered here, and test/harness.test.mjs holds that law. Codes are namespaced by tool; monoforge's namespace is `monoforge`.

monoforge.E_BIN_PATH: a package.json bin entry does not exist in the tree
monoforge.E_CANON_PIN: the .eyes canon manifest carries no pin block, or a pin is missing or still UNSET
monoforge.E_CONFIG_MISSING: factory.json is absent (the stamp needs a config)
monoforge.E_DANGLING_CANON: a .eyes canon ledger row points at a file that does not exist, escapes the canon home, or the ledger is corrupt
monoforge.E_DASH_LAW: an em or en dash appears in md prose (the house law is none, ever)
monoforge.E_DOCS_GATE: a docs gate script failed over the tree
monoforge.E_EXPORTS_PATH: a package.json exports entry does not exist in the tree
monoforge.E_FIELD_MISSING: a required factory.json key is missing or empty
monoforge.E_FILES_PATH: a package.json files entry does not exist in the tree
monoforge.E_GRANT_INVALID: the grant context is malformed (kind and scope must be non-empty strings)
monoforge.E_IDENTITY_DRIFT: a re-stamp targets a tree stamped under a different name
monoforge.E_LOCK_REFUSED: lock refused because the doctor reported at least one failure
monoforge.E_NPM_TEST: npm test failed over the tree
monoforge.E_PACKS_UNDELIVERED: a committed packs/public/<name>/ pack is not delivered by package.json `files` (npm would drop it from the tarball, poststruct#79)
monoforge.E_PROFILE_UNKNOWN: factory.json profile is not a known profile
monoforge.E_PUBLISH_GATE: publish.yml does not refuse 0.x refs (the OIDC ladder gate)
monoforge.E_PUBLISH_TOKEN: publish.yml references a publish token (the law is OIDC only)
monoforge.E_SITE_DOMAIN: factory.json siteDomain is not an absolute https URL
monoforge.E_STAMP_TOKEN: a raw __TOKEN__ survived the stamp (the stamp never finished)
monoforge.E_STRAY_DIR: the stamp target is a non-empty directory that is not a re-stamp
monoforge.E_TEMPLATE_EMPTY: a profile resolved to no files (the scaffold is missing its template dir)
monoforge.E_TEMPLATE_RESOLUTION: template chain resolution failed (a cycle, or a missing chained profile)
monoforge.E_TRUTH_SLOT: a FORGE-TODO truth slot is still unfilled (a shipped placeholder is a shipped lie)
monoforge.E_VERB_UNKNOWN: the harness was asked for a verb it does not drive
